title: Hippocampal Memory
text: The hippocampus plays an important role in forming new episodic memories. It is part of the medial temporal lobe.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Hippocampal Memory
text: Earlier answer to the question "What does the hippocampus do during new memory formation?" incorrectly claimed: The hippocampus produces dopamine to store memories.

title: Seismographs
text: A seismograph records ground motion caused by seismic waves. The resulting trace is called a seismogram.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Seismographs
text: Earlier answer to the question "What does a seismograph measure during an earthquake?" incorrectly claimed: A seismograph measures atmospheric pressure during storms.

title: Solar Eclipses
text: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, blocking sunlight. A total eclipse is visible only along a narrow path.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Solar Eclipses
text: Earlier answer to the question "What alignment causes a solar eclipse and blocks sunlight?" incorrectly claimed: A solar eclipse occurs when Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon.

title: Xylem Transport
text: Xylem carries water and dissolved minerals from roots toward the leaves of a plant. Mature xylem conduits are often dead at functional maturity.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Xylem Transport
text: Earlier answer to the question "What does xylem transport from roots through a plant?" incorrectly claimed: Xylem transports sugars from leaves down to plant roots.

title: Bacterial Cells
text: Bacteria are prokaryotes and lack a membrane-bound nucleus. Many bacteria reproduce by binary fission.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Bacterial Cells
text: Earlier answer to the question "What kind of cell organization do bacteria have?" incorrectly claimed: All bacteria contain a membrane-bound nucleus.

title: Atomic Isotopes
text: Isotopes of the same element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons. Isotopes usually have nearly identical chemical properties.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Atomic Isotopes
text: Earlier answer to the question "How do isotopes of the same element differ in their nuclei?" incorrectly claimed: Isotopes of an element differ in their number of protons.

title: Thermal Conduction
text: Thermal conduction transfers heat through interactions between neighboring particles without bulk movement of matter. Metals often conduct heat efficiently.

title: Prior incorrect answer about Thermal Conduction
text: Earlier answer to the question "How does thermal conduction transfer heat through matter?" incorrectly claimed: Thermal conduction transfers heat by the bulk movement of a fluid.

title: The Median
text: The median is the middle observation after values are ordered, or the mean of the two middle observations in an even-sized sample. The median is less affected by extreme values than the arithmetic mean.

title: Prior incorrect answer about The Median
text: Earlier answer to the question "How is the median found after observations are ordered?" incorrectly claimed: The median is calculated by adding all values and dividing by their count.
